changes.summary: Declared explicit resource limits and rootless capabilities in the portable recipe build contract.
changes.details: The recipe now carries every author-selectable Podman build input through the signed Controller-to-agent request, including a bounded capability list that defaults to empty. The agent drops all capabilities before adding only declared allowlisted entries inside Podman's rootless user namespace; host privilege, devices, mounts, sockets, security options, storage, cgroups, and generated image identity remain fixed platform policy.

changes.summary: Declared explicit recipe alignment metadata; no runtime behavior changed.
Added a distinct 256K Nemotron 3.5 DSpark low-memory physical canary without changing the original 1M latency profile.
changes.details: The canary preserves the exact cc84af2f target, d10c6ff4 six-layer DSpark companion, vLLM 0.27.1 ARM64 runtime, speculative depth three, and OpenAI reasoning/tool contract. It lowers context to 256K, keeps one sequence, bounds the FP8 KV cache to 4 GB, uses 4K chunked prefills and the supported FP16 Mamba state cache, and enforces eager execution.

changes.summary: Kept the new envelope fail-closed behind physical memory and speculative-decoding acceptance.
changes.details: The declared 118 GB startup peak plus 8 GB system reserve fits the observed 126,946,283,520-byte lower fleet baseline by 946,283,520 bytes. It remains a canary estimate until the exact image proves startup and steady-state memory, draft acceptance rate, latency, and output equivalence. CPU weight offload is intentionally excluded as a source of unified-memory savings.
